heading: 2. Conformance
text: The key words MAY, MUST, OPTIONAL, REQUIRED, and SHOULD in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

heading: 4. Creating a Webhook Subscription
text: When a client creates a webhook notification subscription, the subscription body MUST include a type field equal to WebhookSubscription. In addition, a server MUST support the following fields:

heading: 4. Creating a Webhook Subscription
text: inbox — REQUIRED. The URI of the inbox to which notification messages are delivered.

heading: 4. Creating a Webhook Subscription
text: expires — OPTIONAL. A datetime value indicating when the subscription expires.

heading: 4. Creating a Webhook Subscription
text: type — the value of this property MUST be a string equal to WebhookSubscription.

heading: 4. Creating a Webhook Subscription
text: expires — OPTIONAL. A datetime value indicating when the subscription expires.

heading: 5. Webhook Authentication
text: A server SHOULD sign each outbound request using HTTP Message Signatures [RFC9421]. When an inbox receives a signed message, it MUST verify the signature using the notification server's public key, discoverable via the storage description resource.

heading: 5. Webhook Authentication
text: A server that supports HTTP Message Signatures MUST include the signing key in the storage description resource. The key MUST be expressed as a verification method in a verificationMethod array, and MUST be referenced from an authentication verification relationship, following the Controlled Identifiers 1.0 [CID-1.0] data model.

heading: 5.1 Signature Requirements
text: A server that signs webhook delivery requests MUST include at least the following components in the signature base:

heading: 5.1 Signature Requirements
text: The Signature-Input field MUST include the created and keyid parameters. The keyid value MUST correspond to the id of a key in the verificationMethod array of the storage description resource.

heading: 5.2 Signature Verification
text: To verify a webhook signature, a receiver MUST perform the following steps:

heading: 5.2 Signature Verification
text: Extract the keyid value from the Signature-Input field. The keyid value MUST be a URL with a fragment component.

heading: 5.2 Signature Verification
text: Dereference the storage identifier to retrieve the storage description resource. The id property of the top-level document map MUST match the storage identifier.

heading: 6. Subscription Management
text: The value of the serviceEndpoint property for a NotificationService that supports WebhookSubscription MUST be a URL that supports GET operations to list a subscriber's active webhook subscriptions. The resulting serialization MUST conform to the requirements for LWS Containers [LWS10-CORE]. The response SHOULD support LWS Paging.

heading: 6. Subscription Management
text: Each subscription resource listed in this container MUST support GET and DELETE operations. A GET request returns the current state of the subscription. A DELETE request cancels the subscription.

heading: 7. Notification Delivery
text: The server sends an HTTP POST request to the registered inbox with the notification envelope as the request body. The request body MUST conform to the application/lws+json media type.

heading: 7. Notification Delivery
text: Retry: On failure, the server MAY retry delivery.

heading: 7. Notification Delivery
text: Expiration: After repeated failures, the server MAY deactivate the subscription.

heading: 8. Subscription Type Identifier
text: A Webhook subscription MUST use the WebhookSubscription string as its subscription type when interacting with the NotificationService.

heading: 10. Privacy Considerations
text: Inbox Disclosure: The inbox URL is shared with the notification server, revealing the existence and location of the subscriber's receiving endpoint. Subscribers MAY use unique per-subscription inbox URLs to limit correlation.
